name: Dropbox sign-in
description: Signs a Dropbox account in through Dropbox's own authorization endpoint.

codes.dropbox_oauth.bad_reply: Dropbox sent a reply this plugin could not read.
codes.dropbox_oauth.code_expired: The sign-in expired before it was finished. Start it again.
codes.dropbox_oauth.consent_denied: The sign-in was not granted at Dropbox.
codes.dropbox_oauth.flow_unsupported: Dropbox is signed in through the browser, not with a device code.
codes.dropbox_oauth.no_entropy: The sign-in could not be started because the application had no randomness for it. Try again.
codes.dropbox_oauth.refresh_refused: Dropbox no longer accepts the stored sign-in. Sign in again.
